visual_goal: Show Parts II to VI as one road a night travels from supply to settlement, with Part VII guarding it, Part VIII carrying it, Part IX governing and Part X testing.
prompt: A wide landscape illustration of one road running left to right across the middle. At the left end of the road stands a small open gate labeled 'Part I'. Along the road, five evenly spaced milestone posts labeled 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V' and 'VI'. A small token showing a crescent moon over a bed travels along the road. The road begins under a small sign 'supply' just after the gate and ends under a small sign 'settlement' after the last post. Above the road, a large translucent teal shield spans the posts, labeled 'Part VII', with one short arrow pointing down to the road labeled 'guards'. Below the road, a solid blue foundation slab runs the full length, labeled 'Part VIII', with one arrow pointing up to the road labeled 'carries'. At the far lower right, a small control desk labeled 'Part IX' with one arrow pointing into the foundation slab labeled 'governs'. Beside it, a magnifying glass labeled 'Part X' with one arrow pointing at the control desk labeled 'tests'.
alt: A road from supply to settlement with milestones for Parts II to VI, a shield labeled Part VII guarding it, a foundation labeled Part VIII carrying it, Part IX governing the foundation and Part X testing Part IX.
